title: TrialMatch
description: A clinical trial from ClinicalTrials.gov whose eligibility profile matches one or more variants or biomarkers in this response. The pipeline returns 'match candidates' — likely-eligible or possibly-eligible — and never 'enrollable': final eligibility requires patient-level review beyond what an interpretation API can see (performance status, prior therapies, comorbidities, geographic feasibility).

trialMatchId.description: Stable UUID for this trial-match within this NGS interpretation response.

title.description: Public-facing trial title, copied from ClinicalTrials.gov.

trialDataAsOf.description: When the pipeline last refreshed this trial's metadata from ClinicalTrials.gov.

matchStrength.description: The pipeline's qualitative match grade. 'likely-eligible' means every parsed eligibility constraint the pipeline can evaluate from the report is satisfied; 'possibly-eligible' means key constraints are unknown; 'ineligible-but-relevant' is included only when a flagged exclusion is present (e.g., resistance mutation that the trial excludes).

eligibilityHints.description: Per-criterion notes explaining how the report matched or could not be evaluated against the trial's eligibility list. Not a substitute for human review.

drugs.description: Investigational therapies under study in this trial.

locations.description: A coarse list of recruiting-site geography facets. Site-level addresses and PI contact information are intentionally not surfaced here; the full list lives on ClinicalTrials.gov.
